content.title: Switch to an ANALYTICS navigation context without routing
content.intent: Prove an ANALYTICS sidebar item can become active and update the contextual heading while the application remains on the same page.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to the ANALYTICS family by choosing one representative item with the same expected in-place navigation outcome as the other ANALYTICS targets. Risk-gated covering strength was 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss factor applies; no covering array was needed for this one-input representative path.
